label: IGH / BCL2

sections.text: IGH is the immunoglobulin heavy-chain locus, with potent B-lineage regulatory elements.
BCL2 encodes an antiapoptotic mitochondrial protein.

The t(14;18) rearrangement places BCL2 under immunoglobulin regulatory control, increasing antiapoptotic BCL2 expression. It is characteristic of conventional follicular lymphoma and occurs in other germinal-center-derived B-cell lymphomas.
Concurrent MYC and BCL2 rearrangements in large B-cell lymphoma define an aggressive molecular group; this is distinct from isolated IGH/BCL2 rearrangement in follicular lymphoma.
